changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 4 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/5213-widget-ts-retired-spec-anchor-history.md`

- names `packages/types/src/__tests__/page-nav-misc-spec-parity.test.ts` → `packages/types/src/__tests__/page-nav-misc-spec-parity.test.ts` — edited by this change

  > A per-key description of a schema that no longer exists is the ADR-0033 failure: an AI author reads a published docblock as present-tense fact and builds on it. The enumeration is dropped rather than re-dated, and the blocks now say what is true today — the bare names are owned by NOBODY, `RuntimeWidgetManifest` is objectui's only widget-registration contract, and the `Runtime` prefix is kept BY CHOICE (objectstack#4988's precedent: a freed word is not a reason to spend a second breaking rename taking it back; the unlock is recorded, not taken, in objectui#4164). The `inline` collision that made the `WidgetSource` rename urgent is kept, in the past tense, because it is the reason the prefix exists. Both blocks now point at the live assertion instead of restating it: the "the spec no longer owns" rows in `packages/types/src/__tests__/page-nav-misc-spec-parity.test.ts`, which are what goes red if the spec ever re-publishes either name.

### `.changeset/6051-gantt-flat-config-declared-keys.md`

- names `packages/types/src/index.ts` → `packages/types/src/index.ts` — edited by this change

  > **`GanttConfig` itself gains nine members and is a published type**, exported by name from `packages/types/src/index.ts`: `lockField`, `objectField`, `summaryExtent`, `defaultCollapsedDepth`, `borderColorField`, `dependencyTypes`, `timeZone`, `exportFileName`, `interactions`. The entry file's diff is empty only because the export list already named the type — the widening happened at the declaration.

### `.changeset/9309-object-gallery-filter-destination-typed.md`

- names `data.ts` → `packages/types/src/data.ts` — edited by this change

  > It was `filter?: unknown` under the docblock "Query filter, forwarded verbatim as `$filter`", and `$filter` is `RecordANGLE-BRACKETS(string, any) | FilterArray` (`QueryParams`, `data.ts`). The declaration therefore named a destination it did not type: an author told to forward the value verbatim got a type error on the key the sentence had just told them to forward, and the way through was `as` — which un-checks the destination's real type at that call site too. The declaration is now an INDEXED ACCESS on `QueryParams`, not a copy of its arms, so the two cannot drift.

### `.changeset/i18nlabel-inverted-pin-5612.md`

- names `packages/types/src/__tests__/page-nav-misc-spec-parity.test.ts` → `packages/types/src/__tests__/page-nav-misc-spec-parity.test.ts` — edited by this change

  > The `it(...)` case in `packages/types/src/__tests__/page-nav-misc-spec-parity.test.ts` that called itself an inverted pin on the spec's `I18nLabel` rested on one assertion, `const label: SpecI18nLabel = 'Priority'`, under a comment claiming spec 17 had narrowed `I18nLabel` to a plain string and that a re-widening would stop it compiling. A plain string is assignable under the narrow shape *and* under the wide one, so that assignment could only ever fail if the plain-string form were removed — the opposite of the event it was written to catch. The widening had already landed: `@objectstack/spec@17.0.0` declares `I18nLabelSchema` as a union of a string and a string-to-string record (`dist/ui/index.d.ts:614`), and the pin stayed green through it. It reported protection it did not provide, and asserted a false premise in its own name.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Angle-bracketed names in the quoted prose above are rewritten as `ANGLE-BRACKETS(name)`: GitHub deletes tag-shaped fragments from a stored body, and a quote that silently loses the identifier it is about is worse than a visible repair.

Compared the checked-out tree with `4ab4f1ba2` (merge-base with origin/main): 10 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1288 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1857 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36019776830)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f618634c`

### ① Derived judgments

- **What leaves, by export-name diff from base `d7de5348` to the head:**
  - `@object-ui/types` (`.` and `./data`): `ExportJobStatus`, `ExportJobFormat`, `CreateExportJobRequest`, `CreateExportJobResult`, `ExportJobProgressInfo`.
  - `DataSource` loses 4 optional members: `createExportJob`, `getExportJobProgress`, `cancelExportJob`, `getExportJobDownloadUrl`.
  - `@object-ui/components`: `useExportJob`, `UseExportJobOptions`, `UseExportJobReturn`, `ExportProgressDialog`, `ExportProgressDialogProps`.
  - Nothing is added.
- **Nothing else changes.** `ExportDownloadRequest` and the `exportDownload` signature are byte-identical, and the `Import*` re-exports are intact. The `exportDownload` docblock loses its contrast clause and stays true.
- **`cancelExportJob` / `getExportJobDownloadUrl` are the same family.** Both are keyed by a `jobId` that only `createExportJob` produces, `useExportJob` was their only reader, and the card's own census regex requires their removal. ⇒ within 「retire the path」.
- **`packages/components/src/custom/index.ts` is required.** It held the only barrel line of the deleted module, and the hunk is exactly one deleted line. ⇒ the seat widens the claimed surface by that one line.
- **Leftovers, whole tree at the head, CHANGELOGs excluded:**
  - the new changeset (which must name them);
  - `ROADMAP.md` lines 64, 83 and 204, disclosed in the Acceptance notes;
  - `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:291`, a compiled doc-snippet comment listing 「the import/export job family」 among `DataSource`'s optional members. It is NOT disclosed (seat-verified at `origin/main`).
  - `content/docs`, `examples`, every `README*`, the i18n catalogues and the dist pins: 0.
- **The synchronous export is unchanged.** The `data-objectstack` implementer is not in the diff; Type Check, Build & E2E, Test shards 1–8 and dist pins are green.
- **Census:** 8 files at base, 0 at the head and 0 on the merged tree; the lit control finds 17.
- **Removed test rows pin only removed types.** No assertion on a surviving export was deleted.

### ② Semver level

- **`minor` with a BREAKING banner is the repo's convention** (objectui AGENTS.md 版本号策略, enforced by `check-changeset-no-major`). Precedent: `7397-remove-duplicate-chart-primitives.md`.
- **Every sentence is TRUE except one, which is FALSE:** 「There is no replacement API: the protocol no longer declares an async export job.」
  - At `origin/main` of objectstack, `@objectstack/spec` still exports `ExportJobStatus`, `CreateExportJobRequestSchema`, `CreateExportJobInput` / `CreateExportJobResult` and `IExportService` (seat-verified: `packages/spec/src/api/export.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/contracts/export-service.ts`).
  - objectstack#17158 is sequenced to retire them only AFTER this lands, so the sentence is false when this changeset publishes.
  - This changeset is the artifact that addresses out-of-repo implementers.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Acceptance notes:** the ROADMAP note is accurate. The `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:291` stale mention is not disclosed.
- **`Fixes #10247` is right.** objectstack#17158 is named bare, with no closing keyword.
- **`Clause-②: no` is TRUE:** removal only.
- **Check-runs on `f618634c`:** 43 terminal, 40 success and 3 skipped by design.
- **Mergeable:** the merge-tree against `origin/main` `fa5fbd9d` is clean, and the census on the merged tree is 0.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-10247-retire-export-job-path`
Reviewed-by: `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`

**VERDICT: FAIL** — Prose only; no code change is needed.

1. In `.changeset/10247-retire-async-export-job-path.md`, replace the false sentence with the actual sequence. For example: 「There is no replacement API: nothing serves the spec's export-job contracts and `IExportService` has no provider; objectstack#17158 (ruling A) retires them from `@objectstack/spec` after this lands.」
2. In `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:291`, correct 「the import/export job family」 to what `DataSource` still declares. The seat widens the surface by this one line; the Doc Snippet Type Check must stay green.
